name: approval_strip_shell_word_syntax
notes: Shell-word syntax stripping. Harness links the REAL C port (approval.o::strip_shell_word_syntax); twin imports LIVE tools/approval.py::_strip_shell_word_syntax and traces the identical quote-state-machine ladder. PORT FIX APPLIED: approval.c::strip_shell_word_syntax previously stripped all quote/$/`/{} chars unconditionally (no quote state), diverging from LIVE on quoted content containing specials (e.g. "a'b"). Rewritten as the faithful quote-aware state machine (single-quote: nothing special; double-quote: backslash escapes; bare backslash escapes next char); approval.o rebuilt. Covers: plain words, apostrophes in prose, single/double-quoted spans, embedded escaped quotes, backslash escapes, unterminated quote, $/`/{} preservation (LIVE keeps them outside quotes), empty input, adjacent quotes, concatenated quoted+unquoted, trailing backslash.
